items.title: Kenny Barron — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Dick – the guy who lived there. He played piano himself.

ctx.x: Then the next one is near and dear to my heart, 1990, Live at Maybeck Hall, because that’s just up the street from where I live, on Concord Records. It’s a nice hall. How did that gig feel? Do you remember that one?
It felt great, yeah. That was a hell of a performance space. Dick – the guy who lived there. He played piano himself.
